method: Three repeats per timing; one separate heap-sampling session per phase and size. Headless generation/settle/save kernels repeat three times with 1,024 valid same-coordinate edits. Dense-history stress probes run once per memory/breakage case and are not timing comparisons. CPU samples include other investigations; no load-based discarding. Excluded runs include preflight, disabled-undo, invalid legacy coordinates, obsolete gesture selectors and profiler graph-walk contamination.
